стрястись.gloss: to happen suddenly, to occur (unpleasant event)

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'трястись'). Used in Russian as a perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to happen suddenly', forming an aspectual pair with 'стряхиваться'. The reflexive suffix '-ся'/'-сь' makes the action intransitive, reciprocal, or directed at the subject.
